brief:
Bassam Naaim, a member of Hamas's political bureau, characterized the situation unfolding in Jerusalem and the West Bank as part of a "race against time" to impose irreversible facts on the ground, Shehab Wire reported. He framed the developments not merely as a continuation of aggression against Palestinians in those areas but as a deliberate campaign linked to post-election policies.

Naaim attributed the strategy to Israel's right-wing leadership pursuing what he called a "decisive plan." His comments reflect Hamas's assessment that recent actions represent an accelerated effort to reshape Palestinian territories through on-the-ground changes designed to resist future reversal.

title: Hamas official warns of race to impose irreversible West Bank facts.
